purpose: Activate approved skills, run the internal Skill Orchestrator, coordinate task agents, and enforce human approval gates before risky actions.

minimum_nodes.name: Receive skill activation request
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Accept skill_id, manual_trigger, exported sources, and approval context from MeIDs Chat.

minimum_nodes.name: Validate approved skill
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Reject missing or unapproved skills before task orchestration.

minimum_nodes.name: Skill Orchestrator
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Plan the skill run, choose task agents, and keep the orchestrator internal to Agentic Butler.

minimum_nodes.name: Actor Twin checkpoint
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Ask Actor Twin for prioritization, tone, risk posture, and decision steering at configured checkpoints.

minimum_nodes.name: Task agent execution
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Run narrow task agents for source summarization, planning, drafting, and output formatting.

minimum_nodes.name: Human approval gate
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Pause before sending email, creating meetings, committing externally, or any requires_human action.

minimum_nodes.name: Store trace and return output
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Return completed, approval_required, or failed envelope matching the fixture shape and store trace references.

approval_boundary: May create draft work products. Must pause before external action, meeting creation, email send, financial commitment, or unapproved skill/refinement promotion.
